ns2:course.label: Intermediate Yiddish I
ns2:course.description: Continuation of YDSH 102. Develops more advanced conversational, comprehension, reading and writing skills as well as introducing more advanced features of Yiddish grammar. Prerequisite: YDSH 102 or equivalent placement score.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: YDSH 102 or equivalent placement score.
